name: Data Science
summary: Data Science combines statistics, computer science, and domain knowledge to extract insights from data. Students learn to collect, clean, analyze, and visualize data and build predictive models.
description: Data Science majors study programming (Python, R, SQL), statistics and probability, linear algebra, machine learning, data management and databases, and data visualization. They learn the full data workflow: gathering and cleaning messy data, exploratory analysis, modeling, and communicating results. Courses often cover big data tools, cloud computing, and data ethics and privacy. Many programs require an application area such as business, biology, or social science and a capstone project with real data. Graduates are in high demand in technology, finance, healthcare, retail, and government.
